lines.zh: 我拖着肠子走，一路留下痕迹。
lines.en: I walk trailing my guts, leaving a mark.

lines.zh: 我一步一沉，肩膀往下坠。
lines.en: Every step sinks; my shoulders sag.

lines.zh: 我沿着草坡走，找牛的味道。
lines.en: I cross the grassy slope, hunting the smell of cattle.
I lift an arm, then let it drop.

lines.zh: 我的脚步很慢，但从不改方向。
lines.en: My steps are slow, but my direction never changes.

lines.zh: 我走过栅栏，木头被我撞开。
lines.en: I cross a fence; the wood gives way.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边从喉咙里发响。
lines.en: I make a sound in my throat as I walk.

lines.zh: 我低下头，把肠子往怀里拢。
lines.en: I bow my head and gather my guts in.

lines.zh: 我绕过一洼水，不想泡着。
lines.en: I skirt a puddle. I do not want to soak.

lines.zh: 我在田埂上停了停，又走。
lines.en: I pause on the ridge, then move on.
I head toward the lowing of cattle.
A clod of earth collapses under my foot.

lines.zh: 我站着，肚子上的东西在动。
lines.en: I stand; the things at my belly stir.
I rotate my head one notch.

lines.zh: 我喘得很响，像在拉风箱。
lines.en: My breathing rasps like a bellows.

lines.zh: 我抬手按住肋下，那里是空的。
lines.en: I press my side. It is hollow there.
I am looking the same way you are.

lines.zh: 我的肠子在地上摊开一小片。
lines.en: My guts spread a little on the ground.

lines.zh: 我发出一声很长的低吼。
lines.en: I let out a long, low growl.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，血滴落在地上。
lines.en: I shudder; blood drips down.
I simply stand and wait.
I lower my head close to you.
You are smaller than a cow, but you will do.
I raise a hand and point at you.
My breath washes over your face.

lines.zh: 我歪头，像在找从哪下口。
lines.en: I tilt my head, deciding where to start.
The entrails I drag are still dripping.
I open my mouth slowly.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西我不在乎。
lines.en: I do not care what you hold.

lines.zh: 我一步一步朝你压过来。
lines.en: I bear down on you step by step.
I stop, only watching.
Your heartbeat is far too loud.

lines.zh: 我的影子罩住你半个身子。
lines.en: My shadow covers half of you.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里的声音变低了。
lines.en: The sound in my throat drops lower.
You back to the wall. Good.
I lift a hand and tuck my guts back.

lines.zh: 我把被打的地方按回去。
lines.en: I push the struck part back in.
Blood seeps from the seam, slowly.
I raise a hand against the next one.
I turn toward you, more slowly.
My smell has grown stronger.
I do not retreat. I only shift my feet.
Guts torn, and I still walk.
My sense of pain rotted in the grave.
Only raw meat suits my appetite.

lines.zh: 你把东西举起来，我没有伸手。
lines.en: You hold it up. I do not reach.
What I want is something living.
I go around what you hold.
I sniff. Not appetizing at all.
I go back to watching you.
I do not pick up what you put down.
I shift a little further forward.
You hit my guts; you should step back.

lines.zh: 你退开时，衣服上沾了东西。
lines.en: As you pull back, something clings to your clothes.
My arm brushes your shoulder.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我比你沉。
lines.en: We collide. I am heavier.

lines.zh: 肠子拖在地上，我低头看。
lines.en: My guts drag on the ground. I look down.
I push you aside without ceremony.
You step on me; I pull my foot back.
I do not stop. I keep walking.

lines.zh: 我身上的味道留在你身上了。
lines.en: My smell stays on you.

lines.zh: 另一只也在找同样的东西。
lines.en: Another one is hunting the same thing.

lines.zh: 我们并排走，谁也不看谁。
lines.en: We walk abreast, neither looking at the other.
It is heavier than I am, its steps louder.

lines.zh: 我们在地里刨出一块空地。
lines.en: We scrape a bare patch in the field.

lines.zh: 它靠过来，我的呼吸停了半拍。
lines.en: It leans in; my breathing stops for half a beat.

lines.zh: 我们一起朝牛群的方向走。
lines.en: We move toward the herd together.

lines.zh: 它喉咙里的声音和我的叠在一起。
lines.en: Its throat-sound overlaps mine.

lines.zh: 我们之间没有多余的动作。
lines.en: There is nothing wasted between us.

lines.zh: 它走在前面，我落后半步。
lines.en: It takes the lead; I fall half a step behind.
When we part, it does not look back.
I bend and snatch it up.
I glance at it and throw it away.
Too small. I barely notice.
I drop it by my feet.
It slips from my hand.
I leave it be.

lines.zh: 拖着的肠子，扫过一地血。
lines.en: My trailing guts smear blood across the ground.
That heart on the ground suits me just fine.
I have picked you.

lines.zh: 我停下所有多余的动作。
lines.en: I stop every wasted movement.
I sink toward you.
The cattle can wait. You cannot.
I raise my hands to chest height.
My breathing grows rougher.
I have your position.
No need to tire yourself running.

lines.zh: 我的影子已经连到你的影子。
lines.en: My shadow already touches yours.
I lower my head to find an angle.
This time I use both hands.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我就进半步。
lines.en: You give half a step; I take half.
I am in no hurry. Neither are the cattle.
A sound rolls in my throat.
I follow you step by step.
I do not run. Walking is enough.

lines.zh: 你砍我一下，我照旧往前。
lines.en: You cut me once; I still come.

lines.zh: 肠子拖在身后，我慢慢围。
lines.en: Guts dragging behind, I circle in slowly.

lines.zh: 我的肠子拖在地上，声音很轻。
lines.en: My guts drag on the ground, very softly.

lines.zh: 我的肺露在外面，还在动。
lines.en: My lungs are exposed, and still working.
There are cows in the distance, but I want you first.

lines.zh: 你走到门口，我把门堵住。
lines.en: You reach the door; I block it.
The smell of rot, and some of it is mine.

lines.zh: 我抬手，把肋下的东西收好。
lines.en: I raise a hand and settle what hangs at my side.
No need to circle.
My stride has not broken once.

lines.zh: 你退到墙根，墙也拦不住我。
lines.en: You back to the wall. The wall will not help.

lines.zh: 我的肠子拖在地上，走一路刮一路。
lines.en: My guts drag and scrape along the ground.
I never turn back.
This path has only one end.

lines.zh: 我把你逼到最后一块空地。
lines.en: I drive you into the last open patch.
I bring a fist down. Heavy.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的肩，往下一带。
lines.en: I seize your shoulder and pull down.
I swing you off your feet.
My fist lands on your back.

lines.zh: 这一下打空了，我自己也歪了。
lines.en: The blow misses and I stagger.
I stomp; the ground sinks.
My arm sweeps your legs.
You block once and go far back.

lines.zh: 我拖着一截肠子走过来。
lines.en: I walk over dragging a length of gut.

lines.zh: 我一拳打在你的护甲缝里。
lines.en: My fist finds a seam in your armor.

lines.zh: 你的骨头在我手里响了一声。
lines.en: Something in your bones clicks in my grip.
I pull back half a step and come again.
I breathe hard; my hands keep rising.
I kick you clear.

lines.zh: 我从田边的土里站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the soil at the field's edge.

lines.zh: 我直起身，比旁边的栅栏高。
lines.en: I straighten up, taller than the fence.

lines.zh: 我第一件事是找牛的味道。
lines.en: My first act is to smell for cattle.
I lift an arm. It is still attached.

lines.zh: 我慢慢朝有声音的地方走。
lines.en: I walk slowly toward the sound.
I collapse a patch of ground.
I look down at myself.

lines.zh: 我发出一声低吼，四下安静。
lines.en: I growl once, and everything quiets.

lines.zh: 我开始朝最近的活物去。
lines.en: I head for the nearest living thing.
I have no name and need none.

lines.zh: 我的脚步一落地，草就压平。
lines.en: Grass flattens where my foot lands.

lines.zh: 我记住了这片地的气味。
lines.en: I memorize the smell of this ground.
I start looking for my next meal.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边把肠子兜好。
lines.en: I tuck my guts in as I walk.
I stop and test the wind.

lines.zh: 我朝栅栏那边的牛叫走过去。
lines.en: I move toward the lowing beyond the fence.

lines.zh: 火燎着我的肚子，我把它收起来。
lines.en: Fire sears my belly; I gather it in.

lines.zh: 水没到我胸口，我挣不脱。
lines.en: Water reaches my chest; I cannot get free.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，我慢慢爬起。
lines.en: The blast flips me; I rise slowly.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder. I pull it out.
That light crawls into me, cold.

lines.zh: 饿得我连头都抬不起来。
lines.en: Too hungry to lift my head.

lines.zh: 雷打进我身上，我整个人一僵。
lines.en: Lightning enters me; I lock up.

lines.zh: 黑暗把我往下拖，我拉不住。
lines.en: Darkness drags me down and I cannot hold on.
